description:
Become a Better Writer: https://www.writerscience.com/newsletter/

Work with Me

✅ 1-to-1 Writing Feedback
https://www.writerscience.com/work-with-me/

Is the thing that makes you a great writer also the thing that’s holding you back? For many writers, the answer is yes. But not only is it stopping you from publishing your work—it’s also draining the joy out of writing.

In this video, I’ll show you the #1 mistake that keeps writers stuck and how to fix it so you can finally write with ease. The secret? Learning to separate writing from editing.

Stephen King once said, “Write with the door closed; rewrite with the door open.” The problem isn’t editing—it’s editing while you write. It’s like having an editor breathing down your neck, criticizing every word before you’ve even finished a sentence.

But there’s a way out. I’ll show you how to:
✅ Break free from over-editing and write faster
✅ Use simple techniques like timed writing and placeholders to generate ideas effortlessly
✅ Embrace the messy first draft so your best ideas can emerge naturally

Writing is thinking. When you stop filtering your ideas too soon, you give them the space to grow—just like how kimchi ferments into something richer and deeper over time.
fulltitle: How to Start Writing for Beginners
